body.en: “Operation” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Part type on the page is an S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit. Unit: set. φ90 is a small-end kit. A swing-cylinder seal at φ90 is a different page. Material is a missing field. Service life is a missing field. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The S-tube seal page does not point to Electric 20, HBT8018, LZ-60 or any other model slug. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write S-tube small-end seal, φ90, and the quantity in sets. For φ220, say whether the six-piece kit is the row you checked on the machine. For other large-end sizes, do not add a six-piece count. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “操作”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 页面上的配件类型是 S 管大端与小端密封套件。单位：套。φ90 是小端套件。φ90 摆缸密封是另一页。 材料是缺字段。寿命是缺字段。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 S 管密封页没有指向电动20、HBT8018、LZ-60 或任何其他型号地址。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明 S 管小端密封、φ90 和套数。φ220 要写明机器上核对的是不是六件套那一行。其他大端尺寸不要自行加上六件套件数。 标题到此为止。
